why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check your region. The app shows this notice to blocked users: "This functionality is not available in your region (US, UK, Canada, and Singapore)." People there can view markets only, and the terms prohibit using a VPN to get around it.
Open imperial.space and log in with an email address, a social account or a Solana wallet. Accept the terms.

Read the trading-session request before you sign it. Warning The app asks you to approve a 30-day trading session, and its own text says: "This grants session access, not just proof of ownership." Check what your wallet shows before you approve.
Deposit USDC on Solana into your trading account. Warning The deposit screen says: "Send only USDC on Solana to this address. Sending another asset or using another network may lose your funds."
Trade perps. Imperial picks the venue for you, and you can override it.
Keep a daily and weekly streak, link X and Telegram, and share your referral link if you want the multipliers.
Check the Points page after Monday's drop. Balances update once a week, not after each trade.
costs: Points only come from trading, so this costs money. Outside Armada, Imperial charges 0.10% of your collateral when you open a position and again when you close it. On Armada the fee is 0.01%. The venue's own fees, funding payments and slippage come on top. No fixed minimum deposit is published.
risks: This is leveraged trading, and you can lose your whole deposit. Even Imperial's docs on borrowed collateral say: "Prime is not free money." No audit of Imperial's own programs has been published. The terms bar users in "Prohibited Jurisdictions" and never define the term. The four countries above come from the app's notice.
